name: Cintas
description: Cintas rents and launders uniforms, floor mats, mops and shop towels, and sells first aid, safety and fire-protection products and services to businesses, mostly on recurring routes. It is a route business, not a clothing company: trucks visit the same customers weekly, and the same customer is sold more products (restroom supplies, first aid cabinets, fire extinguisher inspections) on the same visit. Uniform rental and facility services is 77% of revenue and 79% of segment profit; it carries a 50% gross margin and a 24% operating margin. Revenue was $11.26B in FY2026 (+8.9%) with net income of $2.0B. On March 10, 2026 Cintas agreed to buy its main US uniform-rental rival UniFirst for about $5.5B ($155 in cash plus 0.7720 Cintas shares per UniFirst share); UniFirst holders approved it June 12, 2026 and closing is expected in the second half of calendar 2026, pending antitrust clearance.

businessLines.name: Uniform Rental and Facility Services
businessLines.how: Weekly route revenue on multi-year contracts: the customer pays a recurring rental fee per item, Cintas owns and launders the garments; high retention and price increases on a fixed route network.
businessLines.description: Rental and servicing of uniforms, flame-resistant clothing, mats, mops, shop towels and ancillary items, plus restroom cleaning services and supplies and on-route catalog sales.

businessLines.name: First Aid and Safety Services
businessLines.how: Recurring route service (cabinet restocking, safety training, water) plus product sales; higher gross margin (57.7%) but higher selling costs.
businessLines.description: First aid and safety products and services, plus workplace water services.

businessLines.name: All Other (Fire Protection Services and Uniform Direct Sale)
businessLines.how: Fire protection is inspection and testing fees on a recurring schedule plus one-time installs; Uniform Direct Sale is one-time product sales.
businessLines.description: Fire protection: extinguisher, alarm, sprinkler and emergency lighting inspection and installation; and Uniform Direct Sale: uniform sales rather than rentals.
